last.verdict: Beat on the quarter, but a weak Q4 outlook and PC slump spooked investors.

reasons.label: Weak Q4 outlook
reasons.text: Q4 revenue guided to $15.0–16.0B, below Q3's $16.5B; margin seen falling to 38.0% from 44.1%.

reasons.label: PC slowdown continues
reasons.text: PC chip sales fell 5% to $8.1B; CFO sees weakness lasting through first half of 2027.

reasons.label: Foundry still losing money
reasons.text: Chip-making unit lost $1.85B on $6.7B revenue, even as spending rose to $4.2B this quarter.

story: Intel has been on a big rally this year, helped by strong results and data center growth. July's beat and raised outlook still triggered a 7.9% drop after a huge run. October's soft Q4 guidance and PC weakness led to a far deeper selloff.

history.verdict: Strong beat and raised outlook, but shares sold off after a huge run.

reasons.label: Priced for perfection
reasons.text: Stock was up about 170% this year, so a big beat wasn't enough.

reasons.label: Huge paper loss
reasons.text: GAAP net loss of $11.0B, mostly a $12.5B non-cash charge tied to US government-held shares.

reasons.label: Rising costs and spending
reasons.text: 2026 capex raised to over $20B; memory and substrate inflation could squeeze margins.
